# iOS dependencies of the CAS plugin

The frameworks of the ad networks are not shipped with the plugin. They are downloaded
from the Swift Package Manager dependencies of the CAS SDK, by `cas_unreal_prepare.py`,
into this directory:

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `Frameworks/<Name>/<Name>.framework` | every framework the build links |
| `Resources/*.bundle` | resources copied to the root of the application |
| `CASXCConfig.temp` | what was prepared, read by `CleverAdsSolutions.Build.cs` |
| `CASFrameworks.json` | the report of the download, for diagnostics |

The plugin runs the script by itself when the selection of the ad networks changes, so a
normal build needs nothing from you. CocoaPods, a Podfile and Xcode are not involved.

## Preparing the frameworks before the build

The download takes minutes and a few gigabytes, and Unreal calls the plugin several times
in a row during one build. If you would rather have it done in advance, or your build
machine has no network, run the preparation yourself:

```bash
cd <YourProject>/Plugins/CleverAdsSolutions/Source/ThirdParty/IOS
python3 cas_unreal_prepare.py --adapters OptimalAds
```

Select the same ad networks you selected in the plugin settings, as Project Settings
shows them: a solution such as `OptimalAds`, or separate adapters such as
`GoogleAds UnityAds`. The build compares what you prepared against what the project asks
for, and prepares it again if they differ.

Useful arguments:

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | Prints what the selection resolves to, downloads nothing |
| `--version` | Version of the CAS SDK. Default: the version of `CASMediation.list` |
| `--format` | `xml` for Unreal Engine 5, `json` for Unreal Engine 4. Default: `xml` |
| `--keep-cache` | Keeps the downloads, so that the next run is quick |
| `--silent` | Prints nothing but the errors |

Requires `python3`, `swift` and `git`. The Swift toolchain comes with Xcode.

## What to expect in the result

- An ad network whose SDK is distributed as sources, rather than as a framework, cannot
  be downloaded and is reported as a warning. The same goes for a resource bundle that is
  generated by a build.
- An ad network that CAS supports with CocoaPods but not yet with Swift Package Manager is
  reported: by name if you selected it, and as a note if it came with a solution.
- Swift Package Manager has no notion of a weakly linked system framework, so every system
  framework is linked as required. `AdSupport` and `AppTrackingTransparency` are still
  governed by the `UseAdvertisingId` setting of the plugin.

## Files here

| File | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| `cas_unreal_prepare.py` | this plugin: resolves the selection, arranges the result, writes the config |
| `cas_spm_setup.py` | a copy of the script of the CAS iOS SDK that does the downloading |
| `CASMediation.list` | the ad networks of this version of the SDK |
| `Plugin/CASUnrealBridge.embeddedframework.zip` | the native part of the plugin |
